rationale: Base station storage was at 99% with loop recording disabled, triggering error E-402, which stops new events from being recorded (timeline stops at end of last month). The purple LED and firmware-update timing were red herrings; live view/notifications still worked because those don't require local recording. Enabling loop recording resolved the issue — new events began saving again, confirming the root cause.

repair_steps: Confirm with customer that new events are recording after enabling loop recording.
Advise customer to export important clips before formatting if they want to keep them.
If storage remains full, guide customer to format storage after export.
Verify no error codes remain and timeline is updating.
output.customer_reply: We've resolved the issue by enabling loop recording on your base station. New events are now saving normally. If you'd like to keep existing clips, please export them before formatting storage. Let us know if you need further assistance.

Event clips are stored on the base station's internal eMMC (HB-100: 16 GB, HB-200: 32 GB). Enable loop recording in Base Station Settings > Storage, or format the storage after exporting clips.
